lead.title: Aarhus University spinout Commit Biologics closes a $60M seed led by Ackermans & van Haaren for antibodies that recruit complement
lead.deck: The Danish biotech announced on November 17 the final close of a $60M (€54M) seed led by Belgium's Ackermans & van Haaren, with AbbVie Ventures and M Ventures (Merck KGaA) joining Novo Holdings, Bioqube Ventures and Korys; the money funds IND-enabling work on COM002, its first candidate for relapsed non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and a second program. Its BiCE platform has the complement system, rather than T cells, attack diseased cells: in preclinical work a single dose depleted B cells in primates for more than four weeks without cytokine release, which explains why two pharma corporate VCs came in well ahead of the clinic, expected in early 2028.

milestone.title: Cancer Research UK will fund and run the first-in-human trial of DPTX8743, Dewpoint's MYC condensate modulator
milestone.summary: Rather than hitting the notoriously "undruggable" MYC protein, the small molecule DPTX8743 disrupts the droplets (condensates) where MYC switches on its genes; preclinically it suppresses MYC-driven gene expression and kills tumour cells. CRUK's Centre for Drug Development will pay for and run the CTA-enabling studies and then a Phase 1/2a targeting ovarian, oesophageal, colorectal and pancreatic cancers among others; Dewpoint keeps all rights, and CRUK is eligible for milestones and royalties.
milestone.why: MYC is dysregulated in most human cancers and has resisted drug hunters for forty years: this is a real-world test of the whole condensate thesis. The model is also instructive for VCs, since the charity carries the early clinical risk without diluting the biotech.

deal.thesis: Greenoaks and Sequoia co-lead, with Andreessen Horowitz joining and Alphabet, Thrive, MGX, GV, CapitalG, Temasek and the UK Sovereign AI Fund following on: the largest private biotech raise ever, six months after a $2.1B Series B, for a London company with no disclosed asset and nothing yet in the clinic. Investors are paying for the IsoDDE design engine and the partnerships with Lilly, Novartis and J&J; for the rest of the ecosystem it is mainly a comparable that pulls talent and capital toward AI drug discovery, and its first clinical entry will be the real test.

brefsEurope.title: Human Biome Institute raises PLN 75.5M (about $18.9M) in a Series A to move from faecal transplants to microbiome drugs
brefsEurope.summary: The Warsaw company already sells faecal microbiota transplant capsules and suspensions against C. difficile infections to about half of Poland's hospitals; Twiti Investments, the NCBR and IGS funds and private backers are financing its new candidates, with no lead announced. It puts its next round at $30M or more for preclinical work and a first clinical phase, and is eyeing a listing outside Poland.

brefsEurope.title: Enterprise Therapeutics wins EMA orphan designation for ETD001, its inhaled ENaC blocker for cystic fibrosis
brefsEurope.summary: The EMA's COMP granted the designation to this inhaled molecule, which blocks the epithelial sodium channel to thin mucus, for patients who cannot benefit from CFTR modulators; the Phase 2 ET-ENAC-03 trial had pointed to improved lung function. An orphan niche left behind by Vertex's modulators.

brefsEurope.title: argenx expands use of Cradle's AI protein design platform to more teams and antibody programs
brefsEurope.summary: After early results it called successful, the Belgian autoimmune specialist's scientists use the Amsterdam startup's tool (backed by IVP, Index Ventures and Kindred) to optimise the affinity and selectivity of candidates and generate new ones. No financial terms disclosed: a commercial traction signal for a European AI vendor.

brefsEurope.title: Nuclera and the University of Cambridge get a GPCR cryo-EM structure in four days, from gene to sample
brefsEurope.summary: Using cell-free protein synthesis and a lipid nanodisc panel, the team solved the adenosine A2A receptor bound to an antagonist at 3.38 Å and produced twelve other GPCRs, six of them orphans (bioRxiv preprint, presented at PEGS Europe on November 19). GPCRs remain the largest family of drug targets, and producing them is a discovery bottleneck.

brefsEurope.title: AAV manufacturer Viralgen (Bayer group) will produce the Gene2Cure foundation's gene therapies for three ultra-rare paediatric diseases
brefsEurope.summary: AskBio's Spanish subsidiary will supply toxicology and then clinical batches through its Aava platform for the US foundation's PUS3, Smith-Lemli-Opitz and GAND programs. An example of the philanthropic model taking over from biotechs in indications too small for venture capital.

brefsEurope.title: FDA approves Wilserdly (giredestrant), Roche's oral SERD, with everolimus in ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer
brefsEurope.summary: In the Phase III evERA trial, the combination cut the risk of progression or death by 62% in ESR1-mutated patients after a CDK4/6 inhibitor (HR 0.38). A second decision, in the adjuvant setting based on lidERA, is due by November 30: a key comparable for European biotechs working on oestrogen receptor degraders.

brefsIntl.title: Marrow Therapeutics emerges from stealth with $173M in Series A and B to treat sickle cell disease with a simple siRNA injection
brefsIntl.summary: Its preclinical candidate MAR-101 links an siRNA to an anti-transferrin-receptor antibody to restart fetal haemoglobin production in the bone marrow, without the cell collection and chemotherapy conditioning that Casgevy requires; OrbiMed, venBio and founder Scion Life Sciences are among eleven investors. An in vivo alternative competing head-on with gene editing.

brefsIntl.title: Lilly signs a multi-target deal worth up to $5.9B with Stipple Bio for tumour-specific epitope binders
brefsIntl.summary: Stipple receives an undisclosed upfront and an equity investment from Lilly, which gains exclusive worldwide rights to products from its Pointillist platform, designed to limit toxicity in healthy tissue. Another giant preclinical pact for Lilly, a day after Calytrix.

brefsIntl.title: Sellas' WT1 peptide vaccine cuts the risk of death by 41% in acute myeloid leukaemia in Phase 3
brefsIntl.summary: In the REGAL trial (126 patients in second or later remission), galinpepimut-S maintenance lifted median survival to 24 months versus 14.7 months on investigator's choice, meeting the primary endpoint. Sellas wants to discuss accelerated approval with the FDA and file in the first half of 2027: a rare pivotal win for therapeutic cancer vaccines.

word.definition: A membraneless droplet that forms inside the cell when certain proteins and RNAs cluster together, a bit like oil in water, to concentrate a reaction; new "c-mod" drugs target these droplets rather than a single protein.

parts.label: Disordered proteins
parts.role: the bricks: proteins with long flexible regions, highly enriched in condensates

parts.label: Interaction network
parts.role: the cement: proteins, RNAs and metabolites attract each other and form a distinct compartment

parts.label: Condensate
parts.role: the workshop: it concentrates the machinery of a function (gene expression, stress response, signalling)

how.t: Identify the condensates where a disease plays out, such as the transcriptional droplets MYC uses to switch on its genes.
Look for molecules that dissolve or induce these condensates, relocate their components or change their physical state (dissolvers, inducers, localizers, morphers).
By disrupting the pathological condensate, the drug shuts down the program it carries, even when the target protein has no classic pocket.

word.why: It is a way into targets considered "undruggable", such as transcription factors: Dewpoint and Cancer Research UK will test a MYC condensate modulator in humans on this basis. The thesis is attractive but still clinically unproven; for a VC, the questions are whether the effect really runs through the condensate rather than a classic mechanism, and whether the first MYC trial validates the concept.

startups.name: Dewpoint Therapeutics
startups.use: Condensate modulators in oncology, neurology and cardiometabolic disease; DPTX8743 (MYC condensates) is heading into Phase 1/2a with Cancer Research UK

startups.name: Nuage Therapeutics
startups.use: IRB Barcelona and ICREA spinout backed by Sabadell Asabys: targets disordered proteins that form condensates, starting with castration-resistant prostate cancer

startups.name: Transition Bio
startups.use: Harvard-Cambridge spinout: microfluidics and AI platform to map and modulate condensates, $50M Series A led by Northpond Ventures with BMS
